paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 5.14 as of September 22, representing a 3.21 percent increase from the prior close and an 8.54 percent decrease over the last 20 sessions. There have been 2 new news items in the last 24 hours.

Recent news includes an agreement between Fermi and TensorWave to extend the closing date of a lease by a month, and a report on Fermi's revenue and loss, with the company expecting to sign binding agreements with tenants over the next year. These reports were published by Seeking Alpha and Stocktwits, respectively.

There have been various SEC filings, including 3 form 4 filings, and a total of 25 filings in the feed. Recent filings include a form PX14A6G filed on September 11, and a form 8-K filed on August 31, which announced the scheduling of the company's first annual meeting of stockholders. Insider transactions were also reported in forms 4 filed on August 27 and August 18.
